guard/30122.htm.text: Guard Bane: Greetings. I am Bane, Guard of the Town of Giran. Our village has loads of items that you cannot buy in other places. If you're lucky, you'll find a valuable item. I once went to buy something, but my meager wages weren't quite enough to pay for it. It was some kind of luxury shop or so…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
